metadata.name: perf-overlay-swipe-dismiss
metadata.description: Perf-capture flow (intent:performance). Assertion-free. Mobile viewport: open the Settings full-page drawer, then pointer-drag its grabber downward one move per animation frame. This traces the swipe-to-dismiss gesture the library's useOverlaySurface owns, so a regression in per-frame drag cost is attributable. NEVER bind as a requirement automation case.

metadata.label: Wait for the mobile tab bar

evaluate.expression: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-testid="settings-modal.grabber"]'); if (!el) throw new Error('perf-overlay-swipe-dismiss: grabber not found'); const dy = 300, steps = 60; const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); const x = r.left + r.width / 2; const y0 = r.top + r.height / 2; const fire = (type, y, buttons) => el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(type, { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, composed: true, clientX: x, clientY: y, pointerId: 1, pointerType: 'touch', isPrimary: true, button: buttons ? 0 : -1, buttons: buttons })); const frame = () => new Promise((resolve) => requestAnimationFrame(() => resolve())); return (async () => { fire('pointerdown', y0, 1); await frame(); for (let i = 1; i <= steps; i++) { fire('pointermove', y0 + (dy * i) / steps, 1); await frame(); } fire('pointerup', y0 + dy, 0); await frame(); return true; })(); })()

metadata.label: Pointer-drag the grabber down 300px over 60 frames
